_about: Hit zone slot NAMES, dictated by Raven on review -- one monster at a time, reading each row's capsules on the render (a row's name draws its rBodyData shapes, see pickZone in index.html). The ROM ships no zone-name table, so a person saying what a slot is is the only source there is. Keyed by monster id, then by damage-table slot (the row index hitzones.json's tables and capsules use). A name here is shown over hitzones.json's community names; a slot not named here keeps whatever it had. `reviewed` is the date the names were given.

em001_04.note: Raven: "Dreadqueen is the same as Gold". Same eight slots on the same joints as em001_02 (slot 5 carries two more wing spheres, on joints 8 and 12).

em002_00.note: Raven named Silver Rathalos "Same as Rathalos", which keeps these seven, the community names hitzones.json already carried.

em002_02.note: Raven: "Same as Rathalos", "Last Slot: Tail Tip". Slots 0-6 sit on Rathalos' joints; slot 7 is the capsule on the tail's last joint (144) that Rathalos keeps in its Tail row.

em005_00.note: Named from the render. Same skeleton as Basarios, laid out differently: slot 1 holds both the neck and the tail capsules, and wings and legs take a slot per side (4 and 6 on the higher-x side).

em037_04.note: Named from the render. Raven asked to verify slot 6: "it seems off to have a sphere on the arm like that for a tail region". Verified from the raw .bdd (build/frag copy byte-identical to the extracted ROM file): record 15, a sphere on joint 5 (radius 95 at 100, 0, 20), carries damage row 6 here and row 4 on Nargacuga. Its mirror on the other arm, record 21 on joint 9 (radius 95 at -100, 0, 20), is row 4 on both. Both spheres keep part record 4, the arm capsules' part, and the u16 at +10 is 512 on both, so the one-sided change is the only difference. Silverwind also enlarges two tail capsules (records 13 and 14).

em002_04.note: Raven: "Dreadking, same as Silver". Split a little differently on the same joints: Tail is joints 141-143, Tail Tip a sphere and a capsule on 144, and Wings carries two more spheres (joints 8 and 12).
